parsed.why: Total-control regime: undefined discretionary morality offences, documented detention-camp executions, official hostility, forced concealment, no civil society or recourse. Outing invites arbitrary state punishment; extrapolated from structural facts despite dated incident records.

Same-sex conduct legal, but police blackmail of LGBTQ people on apps, law-enforcement stigma, propaganda-style child-protection law, and a documented post-2014 surge in attacks. Hostile trajectory with no recognition or recourse; visitor-facing police extortion dominates.

Comprehensive anti-discrimination law covering gender identity, legal recognition, registered organizations, president at Pride. Offsetting: documented Pride assaults, under-reported bias incidents, rarely enforced protections, uneven official response — hostile pockets with weak remedy.

Decriminalised, Gender Equality Act 2019 covering gender identity, judicial-conduct rules, no documented LGBT abuses or targeting. No criminalisation or universal exposure documented; thin record from a functioning state with protective statute outweighs open questions.

Sodomy and indecency laws reach mere same-sex contact; state campaigns since 1995 with beating, rape and killing by authorities; no marker change; bathroom arrest. Mitigated by health-ministry care policy and a strong legal-aid organization.
